title: lead-import response (v1.9.0)
description: leadId = the mirror's site entry id (lead-erase takes it). created false = this external lead was mirrored before (the existing entry, unchanged). attribution = the snapshot the site stored (site-snapshot from its buffered session rows, else cookie-only from the OS's utm / landing), null when nothing was known.

idempotentReplay.description: v1.0.1: true on a response replayed from the idempotency store (EmDash strips the X-AOS-Idempotent-Replay header)
